headlines.title: Why major restaurant chains are filing for bankruptcy: Jon Taffer
headlines.summary: "Bar Rescue" Executive Producer and host Jon Taffer sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to reveal the hidden science behind what makes a bar or restaurant successful. Taffer also explains why he believes AI and robot waitstaff will ruin the dining experience.

headlines.title: Earnings from Amazon, Eli Lilly, and Starbucks: What to Watch
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Thursday, Oct. 29, including earnings reports from Amazon (AMZN), Eli Lilly (LLY), Starbucks (SBUX), and new data released on September's Personal Consumption Expenditures.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Targets
headlines.summary: Starbucks is in focus after analysts trimmed their fair value estimate from about US$112.23 to around US$109.93, reflecting a slightly more cautious stance on the stock. Recent research captures a mixed mood, with many firms reducing price targets while still pointing to progress on the Back to Starbucks turnaround and the strength of the brand. As you read on, you will see how these shifting targets feed into the evolving narrative and what to watch to stay on top of it.

headlines.title: Is Starbucks (SBUX) Fully Valued On Strong Guidance And Recent Results?
headlines.summary: Why Starbucks stock is back in focus Starbucks (SBUX) is on investors' radar after the company reported quarterly revenue of US$9.32b, a 1.4% year on year decline, while still coming in 1.5% above analyst expectations. The same update included full year earnings guidance that was ahead of consensus and commentary from CEO Brian Niccol on the Back to Starbucks plan, which concentrates on coffee quality and customer experience.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
